ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45% high-intensity white to 55% low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white regions occupy the lateral sections of both lobes. A central, solid black T-shaped pigmentation zone covers the peduncle attachment and extends into the median notch. Vertical black streaks and mottling are visible within the white lateral fields.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: U-shaped depression with a wide-angle opening of approximately 110 degrees and a shallow depth relative to the fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitude variations of approximately 1-3% of fluke height concentrated on the inner margins of the trailing edges.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the upper trailing edge transitioning to upward-tapering distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of brownish-grey, high-contrast irregular pixel blobs (barnacle colonization) located at both distal lobe tips. Several circular high-intensity white spots (scars) are detected within the central black pigmentation.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of seven distinct, roughly parallel dark linear streaks on the left lobe white region; three intersecting linear marks on the right lobe white region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle clusters on the extreme tips of both lobes; multiple parallel rake-like abrasions across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique parallel vertical linear pattern on the left lobe white region.
